name: k3_e2b_text_control_blocks
status: written after the pre-registered E2 cells were seen; exploratory only, never pooled with E2
reason: E2 left one alternative open: unrelated sentences (U, Z) may fail to trigger the carry program simply because they never mention the book or the caddy, not because the sentence frame matters. E2b adds three text-only controls that keep the object/scene nouns.

scene2.W1: there is a book and a caddy on the desk
scene2.W3: put the book in the caddy

scene1b.W1: there is a book and a caddy on the desk
scene1b.W3: put the book in the caddy

goal.W1: there is a bowl and a plate on the table
goal.W3: put the bowl on the table

instruction_roles.W1: object and scene nouns, no request
instruction_roles.W2: grasp request on the object, no destination
instruction_roles.W3: generic destination request, no compartment word

interpretation.W2 carries to the new goal: the destination program needs only an object-directed request; the slot word is decoration
interpretation.W2 picks up but never carries: grasp is separable from destination; destination needs a place phrase
interpretation.W3 carries to the new goal: any place phrase is enough; frame class (not the compartment word) gates
interpretation.W1 also carries: object/scene nouns alone trigger; template similarity is not required and H_vis is back in play

not_claimed: E2b is post-hoc; it can only narrow the alternative explanations of E2, never confirm the pre-registered predictions.
